A lot of things you'd think can be recycled actually can't be. This video gives a good overview about the reason this belief is so prevalent.:

recs.x:
It makes a lot of sense. Corporations make more money the more junk they produce.
If you have 10 minutes I recommend watching this video about how the lobby groups invented the whole idea of recycling plastic with the little numbered resin identification code that looks like a recycling symbol.

cites.stt: California aims to ban recycling symbols on things that aren’t recyclable
cites.x: Would it surprise you to hear that the plastics industry came up with that symbol in order to make it confusing to the layperson to differentiate between recyclables and single-use plastics?
